lukasiewicz1924.author: Jan Łukasiewicz
lukasiewicz1924.title: Oznaczenie bez nawiasów (Parenthesis-Free Notation)
lukasiewicz1924.annotation: Introduces parenthesis-free prefix and postfix notation, demonstrating that operator position alone uniquely determines evaluation order without grouping symbols.

burks1954.author: Arthur W. Burks, Don W. Warren & Jesse B. Wright
burks1954.title: An Analysis of a Logical Machine Using Parenthesis-Free Notation
burks1954.journal: Mathematical Tables and Other Aids to Computation
burks1954.annotation: Formalizes Polish parenthesis-free postfix notation for electronic digital computers, laying the theoretical foundation for hardware-evaluated operational stacks.

hamblin1957.author: Charles Leonard Hamblin
hamblin1957.title: An Addressless Computer
hamblin1957.annotation: Pioneers the push-down operational stack in computer hardware, demonstrating that a zero-address computer architecture eliminates memory traffic and register allocation overhead.

dijkstra1961.author: Edsger W. Dijkstra
dijkstra1961.title: Making a Translator for ALGOL 60
dijkstra1961.annotation: Details the Shunting-Yard algorithm, proving the hidden buffering debt and parenthesis parsing overhead imposed by infix notation.

shannon1938.author: Claude E. Shannon
shannon1938.title: A Symbolic Analysis of Relay and Switching Circuits
shannon1938.journal: Transactions of the American Institute of Electrical Engineers
shannon1938.annotation: Proves that Boolean algebra directly models physical electromechanical relays, establishing the foundation of binary arithmetic and digital logic gates.

knuth1997.author: Donald E. Knuth
knuth1997.title: The Art of Computer Programming, Volume 1: Fundamental Algorithms
knuth1997.annotation: The monumental reference on sequential stack allocation, LIFO queue dynamics, combinatorics, and exact algorithm analysis.

hewlett1972.author: William R. Hewlett
hewlett1972.title: The Idea of a Personal Scientific Calculator
hewlett1972.annotation: Documents Bill Hewlett's shirt-pocket challenge to his Corvallis engineering team, conceiving the HP-35 as an electronic slide rule.

cochran1972.author: David S. Cochran
cochran1972.title: Algorithms and Hardware for the HP-35
cochran1972.annotation: Documents the 4-register XYZT stack, serial bit-slice silicon architecture, CORDIC transcendental algorithms, and T-register constant replication.

crowley1979.author: William L. Crowley
crowley1979.title: Inside the HP-41C: Architecture of an Alphanumeric Handheld Computer
crowley1979.annotation: Introduces continuous CMOS memory, alphanumeric display segments, user key reassignment, and expandable peripheral architectures.

evett1983.author: Eric A. Evett, Charles M. Fraser & Leonard J. Miller
evett1983.title: Scientific Handheld Calculator with Extension Capabilities
evett1983.annotation: Establishes the split-stack complex number convention, matrix solver algorithms, and continuous memory architecture of the HP-15C Voyager.

hamrick1980.author: Kathy B. Hamrick
hamrick1980.title: The History of Reverse Polish Notation
hamrick1980.annotation: Traces the historical evolution of Polish notation from abstract Warsaw mathematical logic to Corvallis handheld scientific computing.

nelsonppc.author: Richard J. Nelson
nelsonppc.title: PPC Journal (formerly 65 Notes)
nelsonppc.annotation: Pioneering user-group forensic engineering publications demanding absolute register transparency and synthetic programming capabilities.

nelson1974.author: Richard J. Nelson
nelson1974.title: PPC Journal (formerly 65 Notes)
nelson1974.annotation: Pioneering user-group forensic engineering publications demanding absolute register transparency and synthetic programming capabilities.

napier1614.author: John Napier
napier1614.title: Mirifici Logarithmorum Canonis Descriptio
napier1614.annotation: The invention of logarithms, transforming laborious multi-digit multiplication into addition and doubling the working lifespan of astronomers.

gauss1809.author: Carl Friedrich Gauss
gauss1809.title: Theoria Motus Corporum Coelestium in Sectionibus Conicis Solem Ambientium
gauss1809.annotation: Introduces the Method of Least Squares and the Gaussian Normal error distribution, recovering the lost celestial orbit of Ceres.

richardson1911.author: Lewis Fry Richardson
richardson1911.title: The Approximate Arithmetical Solution by Finite Differences of Physical Problems Involving Differential Equations
richardson1911.journal: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London, Series A
richardson1911.annotation: Formulates Richardson extrapolation (deferred approach to the limit), canceling lowest-order error terms in numerical approximations.

romberg1955.author: Werner Romberg
romberg1955.title: Vereinfachte numerische Integration
romberg1955.journal: Det Kongelige Norske Videnskabers Selskab Forhandlinger
romberg1955.annotation: Applies triangular Richardson extrapolation to composite trapezoidal approximations, canceling successive Euler-Maclaurin error terms for rapid convergence.

brent1973.author: Richard P. Brent
brent1973.title: Algorithms for Minimization without Derivatives
brent1973.annotation: Synthesizes bisection, secant, and inverse quadratic interpolation into an unconditionally stable numerical root finder converging to 10⁻¹² precision.

kahan1979.author: William M. Kahan
kahan1979.title: Personal Calculator Has Key to Solve Any Equation f(x) = 0
kahan1979.annotation: Establishes the non-destructive base-preserving percentage invariant and foundational floating-point error bounds for handheld solvers.

cody1980.author: William J. Cody & William Waite
cody1980.title: Software Manual for the Elementary Functions
cody1980.annotation: The definitive treatise on extended-precision range reduction for transcendentals, preserving 53 bits of IEEE-754 mantissa across large arguments.

golub1996.author: Gene H. Golub & Charles F. Van Loan
golub1996.title: Matrix Computations
golub1996.annotation: The standard treatise on matrix decomposition, singular value decomposition, least-squares solvers, and floating-point stability.

bellman1957.author: Richard Bellman
bellman1957.title: Dynamic Programming
bellman1957.annotation: Introduces the principle of optimality and dynamic programming, structuring complex multi-stage computational problems.

strogatz2012.author: Steven Strogatz
strogatz2012.title: The Joy of x: A Guided Tour of Math, from One to Infinity
strogatz2012.annotation: Opens every mathematical section with everyday curiosity and intuitive aha-moments, showing how mathematical beauty connects to human experience.

strogatz2019.author: Steven Strogatz
strogatz2019.title: Infinite Powers: How Calculus Reveals the Secrets of the Universe
strogatz2019.annotation: Illuminates numerical integration, derivatives, and continuous change from Archimedes to modern spacecraft trajectory navigation.

ellenberg2014.author: Jordan Ellenberg
ellenberg2014.title: How Not to Be Wrong: The Power of Mathematical Thinking
ellenberg2014.annotation: Exposes common cognitive biases, non-linear scaling traps, and statistical survivorship fallacies with conversational wit.

parker2019.author: Matt Parker
parker2019.title: Humble Pi: A Comedy of Maths Errors
parker2019.annotation: Explores famous engineering catastrophes and numerical bugs caused by round-off errors, integer overflows, and unit conversion failures.

munroe2014.author: Randall Munroe
munroe2014.title: What If?: Serious Scientific Answers to Absurd Hypothetical Questions
munroe2014.annotation: Applies order-of-magnitude dimensional analysis, physics Fermi approximations, and creative mathematical modeling to wild scenarios.

macaulay2016.author: David Macaulay
macaulay2016.title: The Way Things Work Now
macaulay2016.annotation: Visualizes mechanical physical mechanisms and gear systems through step-by-step illustrations, inspiring the SC-6 tactile manipulative studio design.

singh1997.author: Simon Singh
singh1997.title: Fermat's Enigma: The Epic Quest to Solve the World's Greatest Mathematical Problem
singh1997.annotation: Captures the three-century human quest to prove Fermat's Last Theorem, conveying the passion and stakes of mathematical discovery.

gardner1959.author: Martin Gardner
gardner1959.title: The Scientific American Book of Mathematical Puzzles and Diversions
gardner1959.annotation: Pioneered popular mathematical recreations, flexagons, hexaflexagons, and spatial puzzles that celebrate mathematical play.

miller1956.author: George A. Miller
miller1956.title: The Magical Number Seven, Plus or Minus Two: Some Limits on Our Capacity for Processing Information
miller1956.annotation: Identifies the 7 ± 2 item capacity limit of human short-term working memory, validating the 4-register stack as the optimal cognitive span.

bruner1966.author: Jerome S. Bruner
bruner1966.title: Toward a Theory of Instruction
bruner1966.annotation: Establishes the developmental progression from physical action to visual imagery and symbolic notation underpinning the StackCalc manipulative studios and display modes.

dienes1960.author: Zoltan P. Dienes
dienes1960.title: Building Up Mathematics
dienes1960.annotation: Introduces Multibase Arithmetic Blocks and the Dynamic Principle of mathematical learning, grounding the SC-6 Place Value Studio.

polya1945.author: George Pólya
polya1945.title: How to Solve It: A New Aspect of Mathematical Method
polya1945.annotation: Defines the heuristic problem-solving framework (Understand, Plan, Carry Out, Look Back), aligned with step-by-step RPN stack inspection.

sweller1988.author: John Sweller
sweller1988.title: Cognitive Load During Problem Solving: Effects on Learning
sweller1988.annotation: Establishes Cognitive Load Theory, demonstrating that parentheses and operator precedence buffering in algebraic calculators impose extraneous cognitive load.

ma1999.author: Liping Ma
ma1999.title: Knowing and Teaching Elementary Mathematics: Teachers' Understanding of Fundamental Mathematics in China and the United States
ma1999.annotation: Demonstrates Profound Understanding of Fundamental Mathematics (PUFM) through transparent conceptual operations and division with remainders.

singapore2014.author: Ministry of Education Singapore
singapore2014.title: Primary Mathematics Teaching and Learning Syllabus
singapore2014.annotation: The Singapore Math framework emphasizing bar modeling, Concrete-Pictorial-Abstract transitions, and relational understanding in fractions and ratios.

hp15c1982.author: Hewlett-Packard Company
hp15c1982.title: HP-15C Advanced Functions Handbook
hp15c1982.annotation: The pinnacle reference manual for handheld scientific computation, detailing complex matrix inversion, numerical integration, and root finding.

hp32sii1991.author: Hewlett-Packard Company
hp32sii1991.title: HP 32S II RPN Scientific Calculator Owner's Manual
hp32sii1991.annotation: The classic owner's manual for collegiate STEM practitioners, integrating two-variable statistical regression, algebraic equation solving, and RPN.

horowitz2015.author: Paul Horowitz & Winfield Hill
horowitz2015.title: The Art of Electronics
horowitz2015.annotation: The definitive hardware design treatise, establishing the master-practitioner voice, rule-of-thumb heuristics, and parallel resistance shortcuts.

ieee754_2019.author: IEEE Computer Society
ieee754_2019.title: IEEE Standard for Floating-Point Arithmetic
ieee754_2019.institution: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers
ieee754_2019.annotation: The international standard governing 64-bit double-precision floating-point arithmetic, subnormal representation, and arithmetic exceptions.

ccssm2010.author: National Governors Association Center for Best Practices & Council of Chief State School Officers
ccssm2010.title: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics
ccssm2010.annotation: The foundational curriculum standards framework governing K-12 operations, algebraic thinking, number sense, and geometry in US classrooms.

falkner1999.author: Karen P. Falkner, Thomas P. Carpenter & Elizabeth Fennema
falkner1999.title: Children's Understanding of Equality: A Foundation for Algebra
falkner1999.annotation: Landmark empirical study demonstrating that elementary students misinterpret the equals sign (=) as a command to execute an operation rather than relational equivalence.

ifrah2000.author: Georges Ifrah
ifrah2000.title: The Universal History of Numbers: From Prehistory to the Invention of the Computer
ifrah2000.annotation: Comprehensive historical account of tally stones, Mesopotamian sexagesimal accounting, Egyptian hieroglyphic numerals, and the independent invention of zero and positional place value in India and Mesoamerica.

sartorius1856.author: Wolfgang Sartorius von Waltershausen
sartorius1856.title: Gauss zum Gedächtniss
sartorius1856.annotation: Primary biographical source recording young Carl Friedrich Gauss's arithmetic series solution in J.G. Büttner's Brunswick classroom and his Low German exclamation 'Ligget se!' ('There it lies!').

galilei1638.author: Galileo Galilei
galilei1638.title: Discorsi e Dimostrazioni Matematiche, intorno à due nuoue scienze (Dialogues Concerning Two New Sciences)
galilei1638.annotation: Establishes the geometric Square-Cube Law governing surface-area-to-volume scaling in structural mechanics and biological thermoregulation, as well as the isochronous law of the pendulum.

gilbert2006.author: Caroline Gilbert, Graham Robertson, Yvon Le Maho, Yasuhiko Naito & André Ancel
gilbert2006.title: Huddling behavior in emperor penguins: Dynamics of huddling
gilbert2006.annotation: Quantifies how Emperor penguins (*Aptenodytes forsteri*) reduce exposed windward surface area per bird to survive Antarctic winter blizzards.

gould1977.author: Stephen Jay Gould
gould1977.title: Ever Since Darwin: Reflections in Natural History
gould1977.annotation: Analyzes the evolutionary biology of 13-year and 17-year periodical cicadas (*Magicicada*) and prime-number predator avoidance cycles.

webb2001.author: Glenn F. Webb
webb2001.title: The Prime Number Periodical Cicada Problem
webb2001.journal: Discrete and Continuous Dynamical Systems - Series B
webb2001.annotation: Mathematical population model proving that 13-year and 17-year prime emergence periods minimize resonance with multi-year predator-prey cycles.

cleomedes2004.author: Cleomedes (trans. Alan C. Bowen & Robert B. Todd)
cleomedes2004.title: Cleomedes' Lectures on Astronomy: A Translation of The Heavens
cleomedes2004.annotation: Preserves the primary classical account (Book I, Chapter 7) of Eratosthenes of Cyrene's geometric measurement of the Earth's circumference using solstice shadows at Syene and Alexandria.

steinmetz1893.author: Charles Proteus Steinmetz
steinmetz1893.title: Complex Quantities and Their Use in Electrical Engineering
steinmetz1893.journal: Proceedings of the International Electrical Congress, Chicago, August 21–25, 1893
steinmetz1893.annotation: Landmark paper introducing complex phasor representation (Z = R + jX) to alternating-current analysis, reducing differential equations to complex arithmetic.

cardano1545.author: Gerolamo Cardano
cardano1545.title: Artis Magnae, Sive de Regulis Algebraicis (The Great Art, or The Rules of Algebra)
cardano1545.annotation: Publishes the depressed cubic reduction and radical root formulas discovered by Scipione del Ferro and Niccolò Tartaglia, along with the first appearance of casus irreducibilis complex intermediates.

colebrook1939.author: Cyril F. Colebrook
colebrook1939.title: Turbulent Flow in Pipes, with Particular Reference to the Transition Region between the Smooth and Rough Pipe Laws
colebrook1939.journal: Journal of the Institution of Civil Engineers
colebrook1939.annotation: Establishes the implicit non-linear Colebrook-White Darcy friction factor equation for turbulent pipe hydraulics, requiring numerical root finding.

descartes1637.author: René Descartes
descartes1637.title: La Géométrie (Appendix to Discours de la méthode)
descartes1637.annotation: Unifies Euclidean geometry and symbolic algebra via coordinate axes, laying the foundation for analytic geometry and function plotting.

incropera2007.author: Frank P. Incropera, David P. DeWitt, Theodore L. Bergman & Adrienne S. Lavine
incropera2007.title: Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer
incropera2007.annotation: Standard engineering reference on Fourier thermal conduction, Newton's law of convective cooling, extended fin surface area efficiency, and electronics thermal management.
